task: Implement Schedulers REST API (list/toggle, run history/stats, run detail/logs) with new scheduler_runs DB table, migration, repository, service layer, and APScheduler callback extension for run persistence.

key_reasoning.reason: Five new or extended components span five layers: new schedulers router, new SchedulerRunService, extended SchedulerSettingsService, new SchedulerRunRepository, new SchedulerRun SQLModel, and cron.py trigger binding extension — a full-stack greenfield feature within a single codebase.

Injecting persistence logic into APScheduler's thread-pool-executed __on_job_event callback has no existing precedent in the codebase; async DB writes from executor threads require careful handling. Additionally the GET /v1/schedulers list endpoint needs multi-table enrichment (settings + assistants/workflows/index_info) with a derived lastRunStatus that requires a design decision (denormalized column vs. subquery join).
